lines.t: In the middle of a war, an army signed up a brand new soldier... and he was a bear.
Soldiers on a long march bought a tiny orphan cub from a boy, and fed him condensed milk from an old vodka bottle.
Then he grew. Fruit, honey, marmalade... and his favorite drink? Beer.
A bear in the army? He'll eat the whole camp!
Then they had to board a ship. And the rules said: no pets. No animals.
So the soldiers had an idea. If he's not a pet... he's a soldier.
They signed him up as a private, with his own number. They taught him to salute. And when you saluted him... he saluted back.
Next you'll give him a rifle!
He wrestled the soldiers for fun, drank coffee every morning, and loved cigarettes... except he ate them.
Then came a huge battle on a mountain in Italy. The men were hauling heavy crates of artillery shells up to the guns.
You see, a bear copies his friends. So, the soldiers said, he grabbed a crate and carried it too. Again and again. Never dropped one.
After the battle, the company chose its new official badge.
A bear... carrying an artillery shell.
If he joined your team, A, you salute him. Or B, you hide the beer.
